description: Per-title record format for the Arcadia High Sierra emulation + public-domain media library. One record per title/emulator. Enforced in code by arcadia_tool.py (stdlib only); this file is the machine-readable contract for other consumers.

distribution.description: hosted = the Academy distributes the file (requires evidence_pointer, version_pin and sha256). reference-only = catalogued with an external locator, file not distributed by the Academy. none = catalogued only, no distribution.

evidence_pointer.description: URL or file path to the evidence behind rights_class / hs_compat. Required non-empty for every non-emulator record and for any record with distribution=hosted.

genre.description: Primary genre a librarian would shelve the work under. REQUIRED non-empty for media records (kind game|film|tv|audio) — Population Wave 1 is organized as genre shelves. Must be null for kind=emulator (genre n/a). Film shelf cuts of record: horror / comedy / drama / animation / documentary-actuality.

hs_compat.description: High Sierra (macOS 10.13) state: compatible = a 10.13 build path is evidenced; candidate = HS-era build known, exact pin owed; excluded = floor above 10.13, with the floor evidence in notes; not-applicable = media works.

hs_evidence_class.description: Verified = primary source read. Source Checked = credible secondary/project source read. Candidate = pin/status owed. Nothing is Rig Verified at this layer.

id.description: Stable slug, unique in the dataset. Never reused for a different work.

license.description: Software/work license as stated in the source of record; null when the source states none.

rights_basis.description: The traced basis for listing this work, in words. Required non-empty for every non-emulator record; for emulators it states that no copyrighted ROM/BIOS content is catalogued and names the software license of record.

rights_class.description: A = US public domain by age (published 1930 or earlier). B = PD by non-renewal or defective notice (per-title evidence file required). C = US government work. open-license = homebrew / openly-licensed with the grant traced. emulator-n/a = emulator software record (kind=emulator only).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the distributed file. Only present where a file is distributed (distribution=hosted); a truncated hash is never stored here.

source.description: Canonical project/archive locator: an https/http URL where one is on record, otherwise an explicit locator string naming where the canonical source is owed from. Required non-empty for every emulator record.

system.description: System/platform: the emulated system for emulators and games; the medium for media works (e.g. 'Film').

version_pin.description: Exact pinned version where one is verified. Null while a pin is owed — approximate versions live in notes, never here.

year.description: Publication/release year where the list of record states one (media works); null otherwise.

title: Arcadia catalog record
